origin_instruction: Stand outside the lift. Point the camera at the large floor number 3 beside the lift doorway.
origin_retry: I only know the saved route from the lift lobby to the meeting room. Please check the lift lobby again.

origin.description: Large number 3 on a white wall just outside a stainless-steel lift doorway
required_features: Large floor numeral on the white lobby wall beside the stainless-steel lift doorway

checkpoints.description: Glass door with a printed Classroom access hours sheet
required_features: Printed timetable sheet fixed to a glass door

hazards.warning: Be careful. A glass door is in front of you.
hazards.action: Push the door open and go through.
features: Glass door with a printed sheet taped on it, directly ahead

checkpoints.description: Room sign 2 3 001 with a Classroom nameplate beside the door
required_features: Room number sign split into boxes reading 2, 3 and 001

arrival: You have arrived. The meeting room is on your right, room 2.3.001. Route finished. Camera stopped.
